profile.text: Michael J. Saylor founded the company now called Strategy in November 1989 and served as its Chairman and CEO until August 2022.

Since August 2022 he has been Chairman of the Board and Executive Chairman. Before founding the company, he worked at DuPont as a venture manager (1988–89) and at Federal Group as a consultant (1987–88).
In August 2020, as CEO, he led the decision to make bitcoin the company’s primary treasury reserve asset, starting with a $250 million purchase.
Under his leadership, Strategy funds bitcoin purchases by issuing common stock, convertible notes and preferred stock, which the company calls “digital credit.”
